correctness.rationale: The exact independent-parent construction yields E final subtree size n/t, and conditioning on parent P_t=j changes the expected depths of the entire subtree. The local covariance n/[t(t-1)](1+H_{j-1}-H_{t-1}) sums by finite harmonic rearrangement to the formula. Neighbor difference [n-j(j+1)]/[j^2(j+1)] implies increasing-then-decreasing profile; root negative and n-1 positive force unique sign crossing (possibly one zero). The uniform estimates for j near a sqrt(n/log n) give normalized limit (1-a^{-2})/2. n and n-1 endpoint identities checked. An independently implemented exhaustive enumeration over every parent history n=3..7 verifies exact covariances all j; finite data are supplementary.
